eightNotEligibleForStrictCompletion.wholeObligationSourceHold: Generic bioaccumulation and biomagnification plus pollutant-effect assessment are not established by endocrine-substance components.
Whole random/stochastic population or patch-occupancy model use is not established by deterministic dynamics or uncertainty language.
Interpreting actual fitness curves and quantifying selection pressure are not established by r/K or generic fitness/cost-benefit language.
SN explicitly supports reintroduction but the current BY/HE-only target lacks a reviewed SN source/applicability route; restoration alone does not cover reintroduction.
Whole demographic sources/sinks and colonization modelling are not established by biome carbon sinks or generic population dynamics.
Nonlinear ecological tipping-point recognition and consequent management are not established by generic management/self-regulation.
Explicit management comparison under distinct climate/land-use scenarios is not established by a generic climate or management duty alone.
A formal resilience concept distinguishing disturbance resistance/recovery and deriving management is not established by generic stability/regeneration alone.
